summary: Iteration 9 backend validation: Resend invite flow (pending + active), training-plan preview, train-real epoch range validation, insufficient-images path, active-learning-queue shape/sort/limit, and cancel-on-queued. All 11 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2323 lines — approaching size where splitting into routers (teams.py, projects.py, training.py, active_learning.py) would help maintainability.

active-learning-queue: For unlabeled images the endpoint short-circuits with a constant 0.85 uncertainty (comment says 'keep endpoint fast'). Consider making this pass-through when an active model exists — currently the endpoint doesn't provide model-derived uncertainty for the 'no annotations' case, which partly defeats the active-learning goal.
invite_member returns 400 'Invite already pending' for duplicate emails — consider idempotent behavior (return existing invite) since UI may retry.
send_invite_email catches all exceptions and truncates to 200 chars — good; but error string exposure to API response could leak Resend internals. Consider mapping to a stable error code.
auto_scale_epochs() thresholds (<50→10, <150→20, <500→30, else 50) are hard-coded — expose via project settings for power users.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_*@example.com users/invites (pending + active) on demo user's default team. Created and cleaned up 1 fake queued model doc in models collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints validated: POST /api/teams/{tid}/invite (Resend integration returns sent:false with clear domain-verification error for unverified tneuralai.com but membership is still created — CONFIRMED EXPECTED BEHAVIOR), GET /api/projects/{pid}/training-plan, GET /api/projects/{pid}/active-learning-queue, POST /api/projects/{pid}/train-real (epoch validation only), POST /api/models/{mid}/cancel on queued status. auto_scale_epochs field 'epochs_auto_scaled' was verified via code review (server.py L1981-1983) — could not verify end-to-end without ≥30 labeled images since running YOLO takes 5-15min. Demo project has 0 eligible images so training-plan returns ready=false, recommended_epochs=10 as expected.
